pattern: ^(SELECT .* FROM .* GROUP BY .* HAVING COUNT\(*\) = \d ) SELECT COUNT\(*\) FROM .*$
correction: Combine the operations into one query and use COUNT(DISTINCT <column>) instead of grouping by each column and filtering for a count of 1.

metadata.description: This rule corrects the error where multiple aggregation operations are performed in separate queries or redundant subqueries.
